A nested table flattened into a cell keeps its row boundaries as literal <br> when br_in_tables is enabled

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"br_in_tables\":true,\"compact_tables\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td><p>Before</p><table><tr><th>ID</th><th>Status</th></tr><tr><td>123</td><td>Done</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
